subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding basic probability as a value between impossible and certain
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student runs virtual spins/draws and records outcomes to build intuition for likelihood
exercise.pictorial: Student places pictured events on a scale from impossible to certain
exercise.abstract: Student describes the probability of an event using words (impossible, unlikely, even chance, likely, certain)

misconception_flags: believes past outcomes affect the likelihood of independent future events

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
